S44.01.needs: a paid account (plan not verified in code)
S44.01.note: The plus button's own label was not found; only the menu row text was verified.
steps: Open the composer's plus menu and click Create image. The composer shows an Image chip with the button Exit image generation mode.
Type a prompt in the message box.
Press the send button.
Look for the Generating image card in the conversation, then check that a generated image appears in the same conversation, matching Expected.
S44.01.where: Composer plus menu > Create image, then type a prompt and send

S44.02.needs: a paid account with more than one image model enabled
S44.02.note: The list only shows models the account's media admission marks enabled, plus promotional image models.
steps: Turn on image mode with Create image from the composer plus menu.
Click the button labelled with the current model name (its aria-label is Select image model). The menu is titled Image model.
Pick a different model from the list.
Generate an image and check that the picked model is the one shown in the card caption (Generated with ...).
S44.02.where: Create image (image mode) > Select image model button

S44.03.note: A preset does not set a separate field; it appends style words to the prompt text, so the look change depends on the model.
steps: Turn on image mode with Create image.
Click the Style button (aria-label Add a style to the prompt).
Click a preset: Photorealistic, Illustration, Watercolor, Oil painting or 3D render.
Check that the preset's wording is added to the message box, then generate and compare the look with Expected.
S44.03.where: Create image (image mode) > Style button > pick a preset

labels.text: What to do with the attached image

S44.04.needs: one to several image files to upload
S44.04.note: No separately labelled reference slots were found; the code treats extra attachments as references by order. Confirm on screen.
steps: Turn on image mode with Create image.
Attach one or more pictures using the composer's attach control (File upload).
Open the menu named by the button What to do with the attached image to choose the operation.
Check that the first picture is edited and the others guide the result, as the send-time message says: Attach up to N images.
S44.04.where: Create image (image mode) > attach a picture with the attach control, then What to do with the attached image

S44.07.note: The button is hidden for promotional image models; the options come from the chosen model.
steps: Turn on image mode with Create image.
Click the button for the aspect ratio (aria-label Select aspect ratio; shows Auto by default).
Pick a ratio from the menu titled Image aspect ratio.
Generate an image and check the picture's shape against the ratio chosen.
S44.07.where: Create image (image mode) > Select aspect ratio button

labels.text: Return the image on a transparent background

S44.11.needs: a paid account and a model that supports editing
S44.11.note: The button only appears when the chosen model supports edit; its visible text was not read in code, so the tester should find it by its title.
steps: Turn on image mode with Create image and choose a model that can edit images.
Hover the button titled Return the image on a transparent background to read its title.
Turn it on (it shows as pressed), then generate an image.
Check that the returned image has a transparent background, as Expected says.
S44.11.where: Create image (image mode) > the button titled Return the image on a transparent background

S44.18.needs: a paid account, and time to click before the image finishes
S44.18.note: No stop button labelled for images was found on the card; cancel is wired through the composer stop action. Whether billing stops is not verified in this read.
steps: Start an image generation with a prompt.
While the Generating image card shows, click the composer's send button, which becomes the stop control during a turn.
Check that the Generating image card ends with Image generation stopped and that no image is added.
Check the card offers Try again.
S44.18.where: Composer send button (turns into stop) while an image generation runs

S44.19.needs: a way to cause a failure or stop
S44.19.note: The retry label can change to retryLabel or a countdown text, so match on Try again.
steps: Make an image generation fail or stop it (see S44.18).
Find the card labelled Image generation stopped or the error card.
Click Try again (it may show a countdown such as Try again in 30s first).
Check that a new generation starts with the same prompt in the same place.
S44.19.where: A stopped or failed image card > Try again

S44.20.needs: a paid account and a generated image
S44.20.note: The button is disabled while generating or while a retry is blocked.
steps: Generate an image so its card shows under the chat.
Click the Variation button below the image card.
Wait for the new generation to appear.
Check that a new image is made from the same picture, as Expected says.
S44.20.where: A generated image card > Variation button under the image

S44.21.needs: a few generated images in the account
S44.21.note: The sidebar label that leads to the Library was not confirmed in code; the page is /chat/library.
steps: Open the Library page from the app's navigation.
Click the Images tab.
Check that generated images show together as a grid of thumbnails.
Use the Library layout control to switch view if you want to compare.

S44.22.needs: a generated image in the Library
S44.22.note: No control named Full screen was found; the viewer is a zoomable panel, so compare with Expected.
steps: Open Library > Images.
Click a generated image.
Check that the viewer opens over the page with Zoom in, Zoom out and Download, and a Close file viewer button.
Use Zoom in to confirm it enlarges the picture.
S44.22.where: Library > Images > click a picture to open the file viewer

S44.23.note: The caption shows model and ratio; a prompt, size or quality display was not confirmed in the code read.
steps: Generate or open an image card in a conversation.
Read the caption under the image.
Check that it shows the model and the aspect ratio (for example Generated with ... · 16:9).
Look for the prompt and any size or quality setting, and compare with Expected.
S44.23.where: A generated image card in chat > the caption under the image Generated with

S44.24.needs: a saved generated image in the Library
S44.24.note: The item menu's own trigger label was not confirmed; the Remix row is shown only for image items.
steps: Open Library > Images.
Open the menu of a generated image.
Click Remix.
Check that the composer opens in image mode with the image's prompt filled in.

S44.25.needs: a saved image made with a non-default model or ratio
S44.25.note: The handoff code shown stages the asset, prompt and image mode; the model and ratio carry-over is set through pending image settings in the composer and was not walked through on screen.
steps: Open Library > Images and pick an image made with a specific model and aspect ratio.
Click Remix in its menu.
Check that the composer's model and aspect ratio match that image before generating.
Generate again and compare with Expected.
S44.25.where: Library > Images > item menu > Remix (settings carry over)

S44.27.note: Save to Library only appears on cards where the app passes a keep action.
steps: Generate an image so its card shows.
Click the More actions button on the card.
Click Save to Library.
Open Library from the app and check that the image is listed, and still there after a reload.
S44.27.where: A generated image card > More actions > Save to Library

S44.28.needs: a Project and a generated image in the Library
S44.28.note: The menu row shows only when the file type is an accepted attachment type; not confirmed for image types on screen. The card itself has no Add to Project control.
steps: Open Library > Images.
Open the menu of a generated image.
Click Add to project.
In the dialog titled Add to project, pick a project folder and check that the image shows up in that project.
S44.28.where: Library > Images > item menu > Add to project

S44.29.note: Full quality was not verified; the code fetches the image blob and saves it.
steps: Click the More actions button on the image card.
Click Download.
Open the downloaded file in Preview and check its size and sharpness against Expected.
Compare with the Download button on the image's hover bar.
S44.29.where: A generated image card > More actions > Download

S44.30.note: The copy button in the preview modal copies a link, not the image; only the card's Copy image is the image copy.
steps: Generate an image so its card shows.
Click the Copy button under the image (its title is Copy image).
Paste into another app such as Notes or a chat box.
Check that the picture itself pastes, not only a link.
S44.30.where: A generated image card > Copy image

S44.33.needs: a generated image, or a picture you upload in image mode
S44.33.note: The button's title is Revise this image; for an uploaded picture, use image mode and the operation menu in S44.04.
steps: Click the New version button on the generated image.
In the Revise this image panel, type a change to describe.
Click send and wait for the new version.
Check that the new image keeps the source picture and applies the change, as Expected says.
S44.33.where: A generated image card > New version

S44.35.needs: a generated image reply in a conversation
S44.35.note: The message menu's trigger label was not confirmed; the report item is shown for non-user messages.
steps: Find the image reply in the conversation.
Open the message's menu.
Click Report this response.
Check that the menu shows Reported and a toast says Reported. Thank you: our trust and safety team will review it.
S44.35.where: A generated image reply > message menu > Report this response

S44.36.needs: a generated image; a file inspection tool for the metadata check
S44.36.note: The visible caption says Generated with <model>, not AI-generated; machine-readable provenance is set in apps/web/app/api/files/[id]/route.ts and is not visible in the UI.
steps: Look at the caption under any generated image card.
Check whether it says the image is AI-generated.
Download the image and check whether AI-generation metadata exists in the file (provenance is set by the server in the file route).
S44.36.where: A generated image card > caption Generated with
